confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Add {name} ({address}) through Home Assistant Bluetooth? Enter the device password if configured in the SwitchBot app; otherwise leave it empty.

manual.title: Add Bot manually
manual.description: If no Bot is offered, enter its BLE MAC (e.g. EC:6F:03:C6:38:19). Home Assistant must be able to connect through a local adapter or an ESPHome proxy with active Bluetooth connections.

abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not a supported SwitchBot Bot.
abort.not_connectable: Home Assistant has no connectable Bluetooth route. Check range, proxy connectivity and active Bluetooth connections on the ESPHome proxy, then retry.

error.invalid_address: Invalid BLE MAC address. Example: EC:6F:03:C6:38:19.
error.not_supported: This address belongs to a device other than a SwitchBot Bot.
error.not_connectable: Home Assistant has no connectable Bluetooth route. Check range, proxy connectivity and active Bluetooth connections on the ESPHome proxy, then retry.
